scientific_limitations: The theorem is only for scalar linear decay with positive rate, backward-Euler startup on the first long step, and a strictly alternating long/short grid.
It does not cover arbitrary nonperiodic grids, nonlinear equations, coupled systems, spatial discretizations, or finite-precision arithmetic.
One related variable-step BDF2 stability paper was available only at abstract level during this run; literature-wide novelty is not asserted.
title: Exact positivity threshold for alternating-grid BDF2
